purpose: Complete authorized mode-reference template. Do not put account passwords, JWTs, tokens, AES keys, or IVs here.
important: Filling this file does not by itself create a working CS mode. Values must come from an authorized client capture and then be validated in code.

br_current.payload_transform: serialize -> session AES encrypt -> length prefix

client_to_server_candidate.note: Prefix differs between sessions; payload is session-specific and must not be treated as a static packet.

cs_ranked_to_fill_from_authorized_captur.notes: Replace only with metadata from an authorized client capture. The guessed MODE_ID=102 plaintext sample is not valid. Do not enter passwords, JWTs, session keys, or IVs.

implementation_checklist: Add a separate CS config mode without changing BR route
Build the CS packet using the confirmed client payload format
Use the live session transport and encryption implementation
Parse CS server acknowledgement and match-found response
Route CS to a separate worker/play loop
Test with one authorized account before multi-account testing
capture_checklist: Record mode selection and Start/Confirm action
Record the complete client-to-server start sequence
Record server acknowledgement and match-found frames
Keep packet direction and packet order
Remove credentials and session secrets before sharing
